en: Yes. I think doing something different once in a while isn't bad.{wait}{clear}Do you have your own way of changing pace?
As a child?
What did you play when you were little?

An abrupt question, as usual.{wait}{clear}I don't have many memories of playing as a child. As soon as I was old enough to understand, I began training to be a mage while traveling...{wait}{clear}Well, back when I didn't know any better, it may have felt the same as playing.
A while longer
May I stay with you a while longer?
Sure, it's a rare chance to rest. You should take it easy too.
Another task
I know the fighting is hard, but please keep lending your strength for the people's sake.
You can be firm when it counts, can't you?{wait}{clear}I thought you were more easygoing, but I suppose there's a reason you were entrusted with guarding the world.
Rest well
At least at times like this, please get some good rest.
Yeah... I'll gladly do that... Why don't you relax a little too, ＄＄＄＄＄＄?
Your thoughts
Do you think things over while you walk?
Yeah, always... One thing after another comes to mind...
Crowded places
Do you go to places where people gather?
Sometimes. I'm not good with big crowds, but sometimes it's necessary.
Eating well?
Are you eating properly?
Yeah... I'm eating... ＄＄＄＄＄＄, you worry even about that?{wait}{clear}You worry about me too much.
Be careful
Please be careful...
Yeah...
I'm sorry
I'm sorry, but please hang in there...
Don't worry so much...
Don't overdo it
Please don't push yourself too hard.
Yeah... I know... Don't worry so much.
Stay alert
Please don't let your guard down.
Of course... No matter the enemy, I won't let my guard down.
The enemy
Aren't you concerned about the enemy?
Don't you think there's no point worrying about it at this stage?
Good luck
Please do your best...
Nervous...
I'm sorry, I might be the one who's more nervous...
If you're that worried, wouldn't it have been better not to come at all?
You'll be fine
I'm sure you'll be fine, Fein.
Yeah... I hope so...{wait}{clear}And whatever you say, I don't intend to let my guard down.
Stay safe...
Please come back safe and sound.
Yeah... I know... But hearing it put that way feels like a bad omen.
Heart pounding
My heart's starting to pound...
What good is it if you're like that?
I'm sorry!
I'm sorry! I didn't think it through...
No... This is because I wasn't strong enough...
Are you okay?
Are you all right? Hang in there.
Don't make such a fuss... It's nothing serious...
Thank you
You fought on until you were this badly hurt. Thank you.
No... Sorry, but being thanked just makes me feel pathetic...
Couldn't help
I'm sorry I couldn't help you.
No, I don't fight counting on you, so please don't worry about it.
Anything else?
Besides items, I'd like to do whatever I can for you. Is there anything?
Don't worry so much...
Pushed too hard
I pushed you so hard that it came to this, didn't I?{wait}{clear}I'm sorry.
An apology from you won't help... This is the result of my own strength falling short...
Asking too much
I relied on you so much that I may have pushed you too hard.{wait}{clear}I'm truly sorry.
No... It's my fault for not living up to your expectations...{wait}{clear}Besides, few people mind being relied on...
Strong enemy
To think the enemy was strong enough to hurt you like this...{wait}{clear}I must have asked it of you the wrong way...
Say no more... This happened because I misjudged the enemy's strength...{wait}{clear}Don't say it's your fault, ＄＄＄＄＄＄...
For you to be so badly wounded... Did you let your guard down?
.........{wait}{clear}That's harsh... But maybe you're right...
Get well
You may be worried about the world, but for now, think only about getting better.
Yeah... Even just those words mean a lot.{wait}{clear}Once these wounds heal, I'll go fight again.
Warlock
What is a Warlock?

A Warlock is a mage like me who's trained in combat.{wait}{clear}Ordinary mages just make special medicines or give prophecies. Only a handful have the skills to fight.{wait}{clear}Everyday life has no need for swordplay or magic that hurts people.
Why did you become a Warlock?

Why I became a Warlock...{wait}{clear}Well... Maybe it's better to say it just happened that way.{wait}{clear}After my master died, I set out on a journey to find someone, and along the way, many Guild lodges looked after me.{wait}{clear}And at some point, I'd naturally become a Warlock working for the Guild.
What do you do as a Warlock, Fein?
Work like trading information between Guild lodges and gathering intelligence on other countries.{wait}{clear}You're really grilling me... There's nothing more to say about Warlocks.
Journey
Why do you travel?
...I had to set out on a journey, no matter what... That's all...
Will you keep traveling?
Yeah... I still haven't achieved what I set out to do.
For you, Fein, traveling is...
Can we drop this subject?
More...?
Don't worry... If this tired me out, I'd be useless.
Yeah... I don't particularly mind...
Yeah...{wait}{clear}Maybe so...
That's nothing.{wait}{clear}If I picked level roads, I'd never reach where I'm going...
Do I look that unreliable?
How like an angel... Or rather, it's something only an angel would understand...
...You might think it's not like me, but I do think that sometimes...
I think they do good work...
I suppose... There may be times like that...
That's... not my thing.
I suppose...
Yeah... Aren't you the one who's tired?
You ask strange things...{wait}{clear}I've never even thought about it.
Yeah, I'll do that.
Nothing special... I just care for my sword... In case it's needed.
Yeah... If I couldn't get used to that, I couldn't travel.{wait}{clear}Or fight, for that matter...
Nothing... I just let my mind wander.
Yeah... Not home exactly... but I do remember the past sometimes.
...Fine... Do as you like.
No, nothing in particular...
Yeah, I've only just started. It's pointless if I don't keep at it...
You say strange things... It's not as if I'm fighting just for you.
Talk like that and it isn't training. By the time an enemy beats you, it's too late...
No... I'll keep going. A little longer...
Hard...? Is that how it looks...?
I'm a hunter. I couldn't do it without confidence.
I suppose... Otherwise all the effort goes to waste.
I think only about focusing...
No... Nothing out of the ordinary...
I suppose... Otherwise there's no point in training.
You always think that, and you come anyway.
I've never even thought about it...
Is that how it is? I've never really thought about it...
An abrupt question... Sorry, but I don't remember much.{wait}{clear}I think I was always alone...
Yeah, I don't mind.
...I know.
Yeah... I'll do that...
Now and then...
I'm not good with places like that...
Yeah... You don't need to worry about that.
Don't worry.
Yeah, I know.
Yeah... Got it...
Naturally...
Don't you think there's no point worrying about it now?
Don't worry so much.
I'm sure you'll be fine, Clive.
Yeah... But I don't intend to let my guard down.
...Yeah... I know...
What good is it if you can't calm down?
...This is... because I wasn't strong enough...
It's nothing to make a fuss about...
No...
It can't be helped...
...An apology from you won't...
No... That's not...
...Say no more...
Maybe so...
...Sorry.
Hunter
What is a vampire hunter?
Someone who specializes in hunting vampires and undead monsters.
Why become a vampire hunter?
It was the only way of life I knew...
